method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Dustin 告诉众人他这个夏天上了烹饪课，而且是初级课程。
facts.anchor: I took a cooking class this summer

facts.fact: Leah 说 Colm 创建了一项计划并筹款，让贫困孩子参观使用大学天文台。
facts.anchor: created a program and raised funding for underprivileged kids to visit and utilize the university’s observatory

facts.fact: Colm 说第一次观星课在上个月末；Hattie 追问是哪晚，他答二十八或二十九号。
facts.anchor: I think it was the twenty-eighth or twenty-ninth. Why?

facts.fact: Dustin 说万圣节那周他在家，而 Leah 去看望父母。
facts.anchor: Well, I was home—Leah visited her parents that week.

facts.fact: Hattie 走进 Leah 与 Dustin 的卧室翻抽屉，看到 Dustin 与一年长男子合影，牌匾写着 2019 Employee of the Year，横幅露出 Clev。
Leah 告诉 Hattie，自从那位作家来访后 Dustin 一直很紧张。
facts.anchor: He’s been really on edge since that writer came by.

facts.fact: Hattie 问 Leah 是否曾被 Cheryl Barton 威胁；Leah 回想因 Cheryl 得知 Tommy 与她复合而起的争吵。
facts.anchor: Cheryl knew Tommy and I were getting back together, and she was really upset.

facts.fact: Leah 交给 Hattie 一封封由 Crawfords 寄到收养机构的信，其中有 Wendy 写的十余封详述 Julian 第一年。
facts.anchor: There are more than a dozen letters from Wendy detailing Julian’s first year.

facts.fact: Hattie 给 Leah 看她刚拍的 Julian 近照，Leah 说他很漂亮，两人相拥。
facts.anchor: Hattie pulls out her phone and finds a picture of Julian she’d taken just as the leaves were turning.
